name: Andes Flask 1L
description: Double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel bottle. Holds temperature for up to 24 hours cold or 12 hours hot. The leak-proof lid doubles as a cup, ideal for long trails and early mornings at the campsite.

name: Polar Mummy -10
description: Mummy-shaped sleeping bag with 650-fill down and a draft collar, comfort-rated to -10°C. Packs into a compression sack the size of a melon.

name: Ridgeline 2P
description: Two-person freestanding shelter with aluminum poles, full-coverage rainfly and taped seams. Sets up in under five minutes and weighs 1.6 kg.

name: Monsoon Shell
description: Three-layer waterproof breathable shell with sealed seams, adjustable hood and pit zips. Built to keep you dry through tropical downpours and windy ridgelines.

name: Lumen 400
description: Rechargeable 400-lumen headlamp with red night-vision mode and a lockout switch. Lasts 40 hours on low, perfect for reading in the tent or night hikes.

name: Bivy Burner
description: Ultralight canister burner that boils a liter of water in three minutes. Piezo ignition, foldable pot supports and a wind-resistant design.

name: ClearStream Squeeze
description: Hollow-fiber filter that removes 99.9999% of bacteria and protozoa. Screw it onto a bottle and drink straight from rivers and lakes.

name: Siesta Hammock
description: Parachute nylon hammock with tree-friendly straps and a built-in bug net. Hang it between two trees and nap anywhere.

name: Summit Carbon Poles
description: Carbon fiber poles with cork grips and flick-lock adjustment. They reduce knee strain on steep descents.

name: Trailhead 40
description: 40-liter pack with a ventilated back panel, hip-belt pockets and an integrated rain cover. Sized for weekend trips and carry-on friendly.

name: Granite Mid GTX
description: Mid-cut boots with a waterproof membrane, Vibram outsole and ankle support for rocky terrain. Comfortable after a single weekend.

name: Quietude ANC
description: Over-ear wireless headphones with adaptive active noise cancellation and a 40-hour battery. Mutes the espresso machine and the chatter around you.

name: PowerCore 20K
description: 20,000 mAh power bank with 65W USB-C PD. Charges a laptop once or a phone four times, and it is airline-safe.

name: Travel Router Mini
description: Pocket Wi-Fi router that turns hotel or café networks into your own secure private network, with built-in VPN support.

name: FoldDesk Stand
description: Aluminum laptop stand that folds flat to fit in a sleeve. Raises the screen to eye level to prevent neck pain.

name: ErgoFlow Chair
description: Ergonomic office chair with dynamic lumbar support, 4D armrests and breathable mesh for long working days.

name: Standing Desk Pro
description: Electric sit-stand desk with dual motors, memory presets and an anti-collision sensor.

name: Webcam 4K Studio
description: 4K webcam with auto-framing, HDR and dual noise-reducing microphones for crisp video calls.

name: K65 Keyboard
description: Compact 65% hot-swappable mechanical keyboard with tactile switches and tri-mode wireless connectivity.

name: Circadian Bulb
description: Wi-Fi bulb that shifts from cool white during the day to warm amber at night to support your natural sleep cycle.

name: Mirrorless Z50 Kit
description: 24MP mirrorless camera with a 16-50mm lens, eye-detection autofocus and 4K video. Light enough for travel.

name: Prime 50mm f/1.8
description: Fast portrait lens with creamy background blur and silent autofocus.

name: Carbon Travel Tripod
description: Five-section carbon fiber tripod that folds to 40 cm and holds 8 kg. Made for long exposures of waterfalls and star trails.

name: Aero Mini
description: Sub-250g foldable drone with a 4K camera, 30-minute flight time and obstacle sensing. No registration needed in many countries.

name: Retro Instant
description: Instant film camera that prints credit-card sized photos in seconds. A nostalgic gift for parties and weddings.

name: Telescópio Explorer 70
description: Telescópio refrator de 70 mm com tripé e aplicativo que identifica planetas e constelações. Ideal para crianças curiosas observarem as crateras da Lua e os anéis de Saturno.

name: Kit Robótica Júnior
description: Kit de robótica para crianças a partir de 8 anos: monte e programe seu robô com blocos visuais pelo tablet.

name: Glow Planetarium
description: Night light that projects a rotating starry sky and nebula on the bedroom ceiling. Helps little ones fall asleep.

name: Dino Excavation Kit
description: Dig out realistic dinosaur fossil replicas from plaster blocks using real paleontologist tools.

name: Pour-Over Set
description: Ceramic dripper, gooseneck kettle and glass carafe for brewing a slow, aromatic cup at home.

name: Air Fryer XL
description: 5.5-liter air fryer that crisps food with little to no oil. Eight presets and a dishwasher-safe basket.

name: Damascus Chef Knife
description: 8-inch Damascus steel chef's knife with 67 layers and a full-tang handle; holds an edge for months.

name: Panela de Ferro Fundido
description: Panela de ferro fundido esmaltada que retém o calor por horas. Perfeita para feijoada, ensopados e pão caseiro.

name: Burr Grinder 40
description: Conical burr grinder with 40 grind settings, from Turkish fine to French press coarse.

name: Pulse 3 Smartwatch
description: GPS smartwatch with heart-rate, blood-oxygen and sleep tracking. 10-day battery and 5 ATM water resistance.

name: Natural Yoga Mat
description: Non-slip natural rubber yoga mat, 5 mm thick, with alignment lines.

name: Dial Dumbbells 24kg
description: Pair of dial-adjustable dumbbells that replace 15 sets of weights in one compact footprint.

name: Recovery Foam Roller
description: High-density foam roller for myofascial release and muscle recovery after runs.

name: Cloudfoam Runner
description: Lightweight road running shoes with responsive cushioning and a breathable knit upper, for daily training and half marathons.

name: Zapatillas Montaña
description: Zapatillas de trail running con suela de alto agarre y placa anti-rocas, para correr por senderos de montaña.
